subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'HOUSE' is written as 'JUWYG' and 'BEARD' is written as 'DKCXF'. How will 'CRAVE' be written in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8448b232103ba63d78eed5a7902d647e85fdfe4b1c3796f7f341fee6159c333.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'HOUSE' is written as 'JUWYG'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f41254eff3390907d20047150844fd0ab4b7d8bd4d74880c5732b34eebcf120.png] 

'BEARD' is written as 'DKCXF'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/130961147ed98a4aa32ec4e1aee04f92645ed7ee3c8fc79cd8029785c4b2842f.png] 

Similarly, for '**CRAVE**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ba4b666ad3f6c7ad178580b6077d3fc3ccbbcfdb78829fd6b2a3710e4d61daf.png] 

'CRAVE' will be written as '**EXCBG**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
